opening_question_spark: If this island has food and water, why can't you stay forever?
entry_transition: Because the broken shelter shows what supplies cannot stop.
cta: What would you protect first on the island?
body: Storms can tear apart shelter and ruin tools.
Heat and strong sun can harm you too.
A bad injury may become dangerous without medical care.
Food or fresh water may run short after storms.
Even with supplies, rescue may not come when needed.
And even in perfect safety, your body would still age.
optional_closing: So supplies can extend survival, but they cannot make life endless.
full_narration: If this island has food and water, why can't you stay forever? Because the broken shelter shows what supplies cannot stop. Storms can tear apart shelter and ruin tools. Heat and strong sun can harm you too. A bad injury may become dangerous without medical care. Infection can also become serious. Food or fresh water may run short after storms. Even with supplies, rescue may not come when needed. And even in perfect safety, your body would still age. So supplies can extend survival, but they cannot make life endless. What would you protect first on the island?
